title: Dashboard Keymap
description: The prefix key and the bindings of every dashboard action, as data. A binding belongs to one scope: `prefix` (after the prefix key), `window` (direct, while no terminal owns the keyboard) or `view` (direct, inside the launcher, task list, settings and help). Direct scopes bind no plain printable key, so typing a search never triggers an action.

Key.description: Zero or more `ctrl+`, `alt+`, `shift+` modifiers, then one printable character or a lowercase key name (enter, esc, tab, backtab, backspace, delete, insert, up, down, left, right, home, end, pageup, pagedown, space, f1 to f24).
